evidence: Has the Tests label and adds microbenchmarks under src/bench/bip352.cpp for BIP-352 public key extraction.
rationale: Adds microbenchmarks to measure execution overhead and detect performance regressions during ongoing BIP-352 input extraction updates. The benchmarks cover standard input types as well as a worst-case malleated P2PKH scriptSig showing a ~23x slowdown (~69.9 µs vs ~3.0 µs), providing worthwhile regression monitoring for silent payments work.
